Rigorous Academic Invariants

Guaranteed consistency across all transactions, timetables, and student identity operations.

USN Roll-Call Invariant

All rosters strictly sorted by usnSequence ASC (1RR25BC001 - 1RR25BC057).

Default Password Formula

[NAME_3_UPPER][DD][MM][YY] (e.g. Amith T -> AMI080707) with forced first-login reset.

24-Hour Attendance Lockout

Sessions freeze 24h after creation; requires HOD or Principal unlock override to edit.

3-Layer Clash Engine

Prevents Faculty clash, Room clash, and Batch clash scheduling conflicts simultaneously.

Atomic Branch Reallocation

Reassigns department, recalculates target sequence, updates invoices, and logs audit record in one transaction.
